dialogue.speaker: Rina
dialogue.text: Selamat datang di pusat kebugaran! Apakah Anda tertarik dengan keanggotaan?
dialogue.en: Welcome to the gym! Are you interested in a membership?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Ya, saya ingin mulai berolahraga secara teratur.
dialogue.en: Yes, I would like to start exercising regularly.

dialogue.speaker: Rina
dialogue.text: Bagus. Apa tujuan utama Anda: menurunkan berat badan atau menjadi lebih kuat?
dialogue.en: Great. What is your main goal: losing weight, or getting stronger?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Saya ingin menjadi lebih kuat dan punya lebih banyak energi sepanjang hari.
dialogue.en: I want to get stronger and have more energy during the day.

dialogue.speaker: Rina
dialogue.text: Kalau begitu, saya sarankan tiga sesi seminggu dengan seorang pelatih di awal.
dialogue.en: Then I recommend three sessions a week with a trainer at the beginning.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: How much does the membership cost for a month?

dialogue.speaker: Rina
dialogue.text: Tiga puluh lima per bulan, dan sesi pertama gratis.
dialogue.en: It is thirty-five a month, and the first session is free.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Kedengarannya masuk akal. Bolehkah saya mencoba alatnya hari ini?
dialogue.en: That sounds reasonable. Can I try the equipment today?

dialogue.speaker: Rina
dialogue.text: Tentu. Pelatih kami akan menunjukkan cara kerja semuanya.
dialogue.en: Of course. Our trainer will show you how everything works.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Apakah saya perlu membawa handuk sendiri?
dialogue.en: Do I need to bring my own towel?

dialogue.speaker: Rina
dialogue.text: Ya, tolong bawa handuk dan sebotol air.
dialogue.en: Yes, please bring a towel and a bottle of water.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Sempurna. Saya akan mendaftar sekarang juga.
dialogue.en: Perfect. I will sign up right now.
